_comment: List every channel here. 'key' must match the CHANNEL{n} secret naming (channel1 -> CHANNEL1_YT_TOKEN). 'label' is a short human name for the Telegram message. 'gmail_hint' pre-fills the Google login screen with that email (also used as text in the reminder so you know which Gmail to open). 'youtube_channel_name' is the exact name shown on YouTube's channel-picker screen (needed when one Gmail has more than one channel) -- put it in so the reminder tells you exactly which one to tap.
